checks.title: Every part the design needs is in the BOM
Switches, sockets and keycaps match the key grid
Controller has a free GPIO for every directly wired key
Power draw fits the USB budget
checks.detail: 25 mA typical (x2 margin) vs 500 mA from USB 2.0

checks.title: Plate matches the MX switch standard
checks.detail: Cutout 14 mm (14.0), plate 1.5 mm (1.5), plate top to PCB top 5 mm (5.0)

checks.title: Key grid fits on the PCB
checks.detail: Grid 57.15 x 57.15 mm: 1.92 mm to each side edge, 5.4 mm to the near edge, 31.45 mm left beyond it

checks.title: Controller fits beside the keys and clear of screw holes
checks.detail: Controller y 16.0..37.0 (keys end at 15.55), x -20.5..30.5, holes clear (keep-out 4 mm)

checks.title: USB plug can seat through the case wall
checks.detail: Port 2.9 mm behind the outer wall, so the plug's overmold must enter the opening: opening 12 x 8.5 mm vs overmold 11 x 8 mm

checks.title: Lid clears the controller and its USB connector
checks.detail: Cavity 4.0 mm over a 3.8 mm tall controller: 0.20 mm clear

checks.title: Hot-swap sockets clear the tray floor
checks.detail: 4 mm standoffs, 1.85 mm sockets: 2.15 mm clear

checks.title: Screws reach the inserts without bottoming out
checks.detail: Counterbored head, 5.95 mm to the insert, 2.05 mm of thread engaged (insert 4 mm)

checks.title: Heat-set inserts fit inside the bosses with a closed top
checks.detail: 4 mm insert in a 5 mm boss leaves 1.0 mm on top

checks.title: Screw bosses clear the switch housings
checks.detail: Nearest hole centre 4.53 mm from a switch housing; the 8.4 mm boss needs 4.40 mm

checks.title: Rubber feet keep screw heads off the desk
checks.detail: Heads 0.00 mm proud of the floor (1.65 mm heads in 1.65 mm counterbores); 4 mm feet leave 4.00 mm to the desk

checks.title: Printed case walls are thick enough to print
checks.detail: Case walls 2.4 mm (caseWallMm), standoff walls 1.8 mm (standoffOuterMm, screwClearanceMm) and boss walls 2.1 mm (bossOuterMm, insertOuterMm) are thick enough (printed FDM; the case is 66.8 x 99.8 mm)

checks.title: Printed skins are thick enough to print
checks.detail: The plate 1.5 mm (plateThicknessMm), the skin over the controller 1 mm (lidSkinOverControllerMm) and the skin over the inserts 1 mm (plateTopToPcbTopMm, insertLengthMm) are under the 2 mm JLC3DP asks of FDM up to 100 mm long; the tray floor 2 mm (trayFloorMm) is thick enough (printed FDM; the case is 66.8 x 99.8 mm). JLC3DP doesn't say whether its table holds for a horizontal skin: ask the print shop before ordering

checks.title: Regulatory standards
checks.detail: A USB keyboard is an unintentional radiator: selling it in the US needs FCC Part 15B (EU: CE, EMC directive). Building one for yourself needs nothing. Using a pre-certified Pico doesn't cover the finished product.
